title: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT……
description: Munshi (by Petpooja) versions before 2026-07-07 have a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users who know an invoice ID to overwrite critical invoice details, including seller and buyer information, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals, and custom metadata. The vulnerability affects even archived invoices marked as deleted, compromising the integrity of financial records.
